item.title: A drop-in Arduino serial replacement for ESP32 that sends output to a Telegram bot over WiFi
item.description: TelegramSerial is a drop-in Serial replacement for ESP32 that sends output to a Telegram bot over WiFi. It inherits from Print and works anywhere Serial does. Just swap Serial for tg. Each user creates their own free Telegram bot via @BotFather.
